# Aesop

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Skincare storefront: one warm ink on a cream ground, a single tannin-amber accent, Suisse Intl sentence-case, 1px keylines (many drawn as box-shadows), 40px fields, 48px bars, 400px side rails.

Captured 2026-11-10, signed out (every captured surface is public); US storefront Sites-aesop-us-Site, OneTrust consent SDK network-blocked. Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Aesop, the skincare house — for building storefront, campaign and editorial surfaces in the style of the real thing. Captured from the US storefront (`aesop.com`, Salesforce B2C Commerce `Sites-aesop-us-Site`) on 2026-11-10, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 and 390 wide: the home page and its search disclosure, sign-up modal, cart drawer and nav hover, the Shop all catalogue with its Filter-by rail, the Skin Care landing, one PDP (The Aesop Valise, APB399) with an open accordion, the store locator with its No-result dialog, the empty cart page, the Demandware sign-in page and the styled error page, plus the mobile burger drawer.

The reason Aesop is worth a capture: a single warm ink (#333333) does text, keylines and button fills on a cream ground (#fffef2); one tannin amber (#945c26) is the only accent (badges, promos, inline links); Suisse Intl in two cuts sets everything in sentence case; rules are 1px hairlines, many drawn as box-shadows; corners are square; the footer inverts to cream-on-ink.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **PDP readings taken past a bot check.** aesop.com's Cloudflare Turnstile challenges the second document a browser context loads. The committed product-page readings (15 entries measured on `pdp`, the footer among them, and the mobile `accordion`) and the five `pdp-light-*` and `mobile-pdp-light-*` screenshots were taken by opening the product page as the first document of a fresh context, which got past the challenge. The capture scripts no longer do this (not run since): [tools/capture/public/gate.mjs](tools/capture/public/gate.mjs) loads each page once, a recapture reaches the PDP from the catalogue in the same context, and a challenged page is recorded as blocked and never measured or shot, with the earlier readings kept. [tools/capture/public/test_gate.mjs](tools/capture/public/test_gate.mjs) drives that with a stub page. A recapture may therefore leave the PDP as a boundary.
- **Readings past a masked bot signal.** The committed screenshots and readings were taken with `navigator.webdriver` masked, the flag bot checks read to spot automation. The capture scripts no longer mask it (not run since), so a recapture may record a walled route as a boundary instead of a reading.
- The capture is the US storefront; other regions (different assortment, promos, footer copy) were not visited.
- The ADD TO CART bar was caught mid-hydration labelled "Loading …" — the resting label state was not captured.
- The sign-up modal's remote fragment never rendered in headless; the dialog was measured as an empty shell.
- The cart drawer's body logs a JSON parse warning in headless; the drawer chrome measured fine.
- Several components were re-measured after selector fixes; `search-panel` (its container) and `cart-close` (no measurable close button) are honest misses, and `qty-select` does not exist on a one-variant PDP.
- **`pdp-subtitle` was read from the wrong element.** Its text search matched the breadcrumb crumb ("Seasonal Gift Kits"), not the descriptor line under the product name. Needs a recapture.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do set it in ink on cream.** One warm ink #333333 on #fffef2 carries text, keylines and the dark fills ([header](components/crops/header-default.png), [footer](components/crops/footer-default.png)).
- **Do spend the one amber on badges and links.** #945c26 marks New addition / Beloved formulation tiles, promos and inline links — nothing else ([tile-badge](components/crops/tile-badge-default.png)).
- **Do keep labels sentence case in Suisse Intl.** Nav, buttons and badges run the medium cut; body and prices the regular — never uppercase ([nav-link](components/crops/nav-link-default.png), [product-card-name](components/crops/product-card-name-default.png)).
- **Do draw edges as 1px keylines, often as shadows.** Hairlines are 1px — many computed as `rgb(51,51,51) 0 0 0 1px` box-shadow rather than border ([newsletter-field](components/crops/newsletter-field-default.png), [variant-box](components/crops/variant-box-default.png)).
- **Do give controls one geometry.** Fields are 40px tall; buttons and CTA cards 48px with 24/13 padding; drawers 400-405px ([search-field](components/crops/search-field-default.png), [add-to-cart](components/crops/add-to-cart-default.png), [cart-panel](components/crops/cart-panel-default.png)).
- **Don't round, shadow or ease the controls.** Corners stay 0px, elevation is absent, and most state changes are instant ([hero-cta](components/crops/hero-cta-hover.png)).
- **Don't expect a focus ring.** None paints on the measured controls — keyboard focus lands with at most a colour shift ([footer-link](components/crops/footer-link-focus-visible.png)).
